preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10000, inclusive.
The number of digits in N is between 1 and 18, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is the rank of N among all numbers that can be formed with the same digits
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should be the rank of the given number N among all numbers that can be formed with the same digits as N.
